# function: appmesh_preview_gateway_route

Builds the ARN of an `appmesh-preview` `gatewayRoute`:

```
arn:${Partition}:appmesh-preview:${Region}:${Account}:mesh/${MeshName}/virtualGateway/${VirtualGatewayName}/gatewayRoute/${GatewayRouteName}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
appmesh_preview_gateway_route(mesh_name string, virtual_gateway_name string, gateway_route_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `mesh_name` (String) Value for `${MeshName}` in the ARN template.
1. `virtual_gateway_name` (String) Value for `${VirtualGatewayName}` in the ARN template.
1. `gateway_route_name` (String) Value for `${GatewayRouteName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
